layout-missing-cache-ttl.title: Add Cache TTL to Layout Block
layout-missing-cache-ttl.action: Add cacheable="true" and ttl attribute to block element
layout-missing-cache-ttl.values:
Dynamic content: 3600s (1 hour)
Semi-static: 21600s (6 hours)
Static: 86400s (24 hours)
layout-missing-cache-ttl.impact: Reduces server load 30-50%, improves page load 200-500ms

opcache-max-files-too-low.title: Increase OPcache Max Accelerated Files
opcache-max-files-too-low.impact: 15-25% faster PHP execution, better memory utilization

opcache-interned-strings-low.title: Increase OPcache Interned Strings Buffer
opcache-interned-strings-low.action: Increase opcache.interned_strings_buffer for better memory efficiency
opcache-interned-strings-low.impact: Reduces memory usage, faster string operations

graphql-complexity-unlimited.title: Add GraphQL Query Complexity Limit
graphql-complexity-unlimited.action: Implement query complexity and depth limits to prevent resource exhaustion
graphql-complexity-unlimited.impact: Prevents DoS attacks, protects server resources

server-php-fpm-not-running.title: CRITICAL: Start PHP-FPM Service
server-php-fpm-not-running.action: PHP-FPM service is not running. Start immediately.
server-php-fpm-not-running.command:
# Check status
sudo systemctl status php-fpm

# Start service
sudo systemctl start php-fpm

# Enable auto-start
sudo systemctl enable php-fpm
server-php-fpm-not-running.troubleshoot:
If won't start:
1. Check logs: tail -f /var/log/php-fpm/error.log
2. Test config: php-fpm -t
3. Check port: netstat -tulpn | grep 9000
server-php-fpm-not-running.impact: CRITICAL: Site is completely down without this

search-engine-not-elasticsearch.title: Switch to Elasticsearch for Better Search Performance
search-engine-not-elasticsearch.action: MySQL search is slow and limited. Configure Elasticsearch for production.
search-engine-not-elasticsearch.command:
# Configure Magento
bin/magento config:set catalog/search/engine elasticsearch7
bin/magento config:set catalog/search/elasticsearch7_server_hostname localhost
bin/magento config:set catalog/search/elasticsearch7_server_port 9200

# Reindex
bin/magento indexer:reindex catalogsearch_fulltext
search-engine-not-elasticsearch.impact: Search speed 10-50x faster, better relevance, faceted search enabled

cdn-not-detected.title: Implement CDN for Static Assets
cdn-not-detected.action: Configure CDN to serve static assets for 40-60% faster global load times
cdn-not-detected.steps:
1. Choose CDN provider (Cloudflare free tier recommended)
2. Stores → Configuration → Web → Base URLs
3. Set 'Base URL for Static View Files'
4. Set 'Base URL for User Media Files'
5. Deploy static content
6. Test: View page source, verify assets load from CDN
cdn-not-detected.impact: Global page load -40-60%, origin server load -60-80%, bandwidth cost -50-70%

database-query-n-plus-one.title: Fix N+1 Query Problem
database-query-n-plus-one.action: Loading items in loop causes N+1 queries. Use collection loading or join.
database-query-n-plus-one.impact: Reduces database queries from N+1 to 1, 80-95% faster

cache-disabled.title: Enable Magento Cache Types
cache-disabled.action: Critical cache types are disabled. Enable for production.
cache-disabled.command:
# Enable all caches
bin/magento cache:enable

# Or specific caches
bin/magento cache:enable config layout block_html full_page

flat-catalog-disabled.title: Enable Flat Catalog for Better Performance
flat-catalog-disabled.action: Flat catalog reduces EAV queries and improves product/category load times
flat-catalog-disabled.command:
bin/magento config:set catalog/frontend/flat_catalog_category 1
bin/magento config:set catalog/frontend/flat_catalog_product 1
bin/magento indexer:reindex catalog_category_flat catalog_product_flat
flat-catalog-disabled.impact: Category pages 30-50% faster, product pages 20-40% faster
flat-catalog-disabled.note: Requires additional disk space, increases indexing time
